name: dev-workflow-standard
description: Reusable project development standard for documentation structure, local project instructions, Codex planning, Claude Code implementation delegation, QA, security review, and delivery checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Standardize docs, project instructions, planning, delegation, QA, and delivery.
interface.longDescription: Dev Workflow Standard gives Codex a reusable development methodology for any software project: establish project documentation structure, inspect the environment, define checkpoints, plan architecture, delegate non-trivial implementation to Claude Code in bounded checkpoints, review each diff, run validation, and report status by Banco, API/Backend, and Frontend/UI.
defaultPrompt: Use Dev Workflow Standard to plan and implement this project with checkpoints.
Use Dev Workflow Standard to initialize this project's docs and local instruction structure.
Use Dev Workflow Standard to review this repository and create the next development plan.
Use Dev Workflow Standard to delegate implementation to Claude Code and then review the diff.
